entries.title: Psalms 100:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm of Praise.> Make a glad sound to the Lord, all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 100:2
segments: Give worship to the Lord with joy; come before him with a song.

entries.title: Psalms 100:3
segments: Be certain that the Lord is God; it is he who has made us, and we are his; we are his people, and the sheep to whom he gives food.

entries.title: Psalms 100:4
segments: Come into his doors with joy, and into his house with praise; give him honour, blessing his name.

entries.title: Psalms 100:5
segments: For the Lord is good, and his mercy is never-ending; his faith is unchanging through all generations.
